old_problem: The Master row required an affirmative PFR-governed BMC update but omitted the AST1060 lifecycle/lock state, trust-key provenance, capsule identity/compatibility, activation and expected-version oracle, final provisioning state and external recovery. DeepSeek instead described a different negative corrupt/downgrade rejection test.
disposition_reason: ED-07 requires this Flash-containing source coverage to remain an actual signed capsule update with pre/post version verification and independent authorization; corrupt or older-image rejection belongs to separate cases and cannot substitute. Provisioning a trust key, staging/verifying/activating a capsule, and erasing unlocked provisioning data are three distinct security-state mutations with different irreversibility and recovery consequences. The exact AST1060 lifecycle, whether the device is locked, approved initial/final state, key/config trust, capsule compatibility, activation flow and programmer/golden recovery are OEM/project authorities and cannot be inferred from generic PFR concepts. Pending therefore remains. The purpose and expected vendor artifacts are identifiable, so the missing package/approval alone does not change the review classification to BLOCKED.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Functionality rows 2278 and 2279 with row-2278 Items, complete Procedure, Criteria and DeepSeek fields; row 2279 is the verified next formal pending case.
Read GPT V2/historical record 2399 and retained the exact Source Key, Variant ID and row hash.
Preserve `aspeed-pfr-tool -p show`, conditional provisioning, affirmative capsule update, Root-of-Trust verification, BMC boot and the source's stated unprovision coverage as separate checkpoints.
Reject DeepSeek's corrupt/downgrade substitution because a rejection path cannot prove valid-image stage, verify, activate and boot behavior.
ED-12 forbids automatic retry and ED-17 requires evidence export before any potentially destructive event/log action.
No provisioning, unprovisioning, image staging, Flash, activation, reboot or DUT query occurred.

test_case.test_name: AST1060 PFR authorized BMC capsule update and approved final trust state
test_case.purpose: Verify that the exact platform accepts and activates one authorized signed BMC capsule through the required AST1060 Root-of-Trust state, boots the expected BMC version with healthy services, and finishes in the explicitly approved provisioning state.
required_package: SUT/BMC/AST1060 identities, firmware versions, lifecycle and lock/fuse state
Approved initial and final provisioning-state transition diagram
Trusted rk384 public key/config source, signature and hash if provisioning is permitted
Signed BMC capsule version, hash, compatibility manifest and vendor update/activation runbook
Golden/recovery image, full backup, independent console, correct SPI programmer/adapter and rollback procedure
Separate written authorizations for provisioning, Flash/update activation and any unprovision operation
test_case.test_command: Capture provision/lifecycle/lock state and BMC version/health; validate the signed key/config and capsule against the exact target; confirm stable power and external recovery readiness. Execute only the separately authorized state transition: provision if explicitly allowed and required, submit exactly one approved capsule through the vendor PFR update flow, monitor verification/task/activation and BMC boot, verify the expected new version and full management readiness, then run `--unprovision` only when the signed lifecycle plan separately requires it and verify the approved final state.
test_case.expected_result: Every authorized transition starts from the expected AST1060 state, the exact capsule passes Root-of-Trust verification, update and activation complete once, the BMC boots the declared target version and passes the management-service checklist, no unexplained PFR/SEL event occurs, and provisioning ends in the owner-approved state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable key/capsule provenance, correct target compatibility, separate approvals, complete PFR verification/task/activation evidence, expected pre/post version change, successful BMC boot/readiness and exact final trust state. Rejection of a bad/old image, unchanged version after a supposed valid update, implicit provisioning, unauthorized `--unprovision`, missing recovery readiness, retry or boot-only evidence is not PASS. The end engineer decides PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Treat provisioning, capsule Flash/activation and unprovisioning as independently authorized mutations; never chain them by default.
Stop if lifecycle/lock state, target identity, key/config/capsule hash or compatibility differs from the signed package.
Maintain uninterrupted qualified power, independent console and verified golden/programmer recovery for the entire operation.
Export existing PFR/SEL/task evidence before mutation and do not clear it to manufacture a baseline.
On verification, task, activation, boot or state anomaly, preserve evidence and do not automatically retry, erase or power-cycle.
expected_evidence: Row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/AST1060 firmware plus lifecycle/lock pre-state
Initial/final state-machine approval and separate mutation authorizations
Key/config and capsule provenance, signature, hashes and compatibility
Exact vendor commands, complete update task, PFR verification and activation logs
Pre/post BMC version, boot timeline, IPMI/Redfish/Web service readiness and PFR/SEL events
Final provisioning/lock state and documented recovery readiness or actions
test_case.recovery: On any unexpected PFR state, failed verification/task, activation timeout or absent BMC boot, stop further tool operations, preserve console/PFR/task/SEL evidence, keep power according to the vendor recovery runbook, and invoke the approved golden-image or external-programmer recovery. Unprovision, retry and power interruption require new explicit authorization.
